Software Engineer I (Entry Level/ Early Careers)
United States
Full-time
Remote
Entry Level
$49K/yr - $93K/yr
Capital Blue Cross seeks a Software Engineer I to analyze business needs and develop, test, maintain, and support automated IT solutions. The role works closely with customers to define requirements, evaluate implementation options, and support business systems.
Consulting
Healthcare
Health Insurance
Professional Services
Health Care
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Responsible for one or more of the following: leading, planning and controlling projects; defining customer requirements; analyzing and designing solutions to business problems; programming new systems; maintaining existing systems; coordinating creation and change of data structures; integrating vendor packages; researching new tools, technologies, or platforms; thoroughly testing all program logic; creating test plans; and supporting the customer. When analyzing and designing solutions, the incumbent is responsible for developing cost effective automated solutions that meet business requirements. To successfully accomplish this goal, close customer contact is required. The incumbent reviews current procedures/systems and proposes recommended solutions and alternatives to satisfy customer requests for system enhancements
Analyzes/researches business problems to determine the impact on existing business and IT systems and procedures, as well as the feasibility of automation
Conforms with PMO guidelines and procedures when developing IT solutions to defined business problems using structured methodologies. Conducts meetings with customers to ensure requirements are defined and adequately satisfied
Designs innovative solutions using emerging and existing technologies for business problems and determines feasibility and practicality of implementation within current or future environments
Prepares test data and conducts program and system tests to ensure compliance. Assists customers in establishing acceptance criteria and effectiveness of proposed solutions
Maintains knowledge of the department’s programming languages and tools, coding and design techniques, data base management systems, processing platforms and emerging technologies through continued education
Qualification
ETL Development
Subversion
Oracle PL/SQL
EngageOne (Streamweaver)
Tidal Batch Scheduling
ITIL Service Management
Claims Processing
Integrated Business Systems
Required
Ability to learn and support new technologies as needs arise
Knowledge of ITIL service management concepts including change, incident, and request management
Experience and knowledge of ETL development tools
Experience with Subversion as a source code management tool
Experience working with an enterprise batch schedule (i.e. Tidal). Ability to understand complex dependencies between batch jobs and requirements for defining new batch jobs in an existing schedule
Experience working with integrated business systems that handles claims processing, membership, billing, network, clinical, customer service, and product processes
An Associate's or Bachelor's Degree in one of the following; information systems, computer science, mathematics, or engineering or equivalent work experience
Preferred
Experience developing Oracle PL/SQL stored procedures
Experience with EngageOne (a.k.a Streamweaver)
Experience with BCBSA or FEP claims processes
